import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
titanic_data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the aesthetics for the plot
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot for survival based on class and sex
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=titanic_data, x='pclass', hue='sex', palette='Set2', order=titanic_data['pclass'].value_counts().index)

# Labeling the axes and title
plt.title('Survival of Titanic Passengers by Class and Sex', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Sex', fontsize=12)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
